senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; פָּלָא)a specified person or thing, such and such, name ‘blank’ (abbrev. פלו׳).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 6:3">Gitt. VI, 3</cite> <he>במקים פ׳</he> in such and such a place. Y. ib. VIII, end, 49ᵈ (in a document) <he>אני פ׳ בן פ׳</he> I—, son of—.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 65a:20">Kidd. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>קידשתיך בפני פ׳ ופ׳ והלכו וכ׳</he> I betrothed thee unto me in the presence of—and—, and they have left &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 3:4">Tosef. Yeb. III, 4</cite> <he>ופ׳ מהו לעה״ב</he> and will such and such a man have a share in the hereafter?; <he>דומה שלא שאלתם אלא על פ׳</he> it seems to me that you inquired about such and such (naming some one else); <cite ref="Yoma 66b:9">Yoma 66ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
Koh. R. to I, 8, v. יֵשׁוּ.—Fem. פְּלוֹנִית, פְּלֹנִית.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:1">Kidd. III, 1</cite> <he>צא וקדש לי אשה פ׳</he> go and betroth for me that certain woman.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 6:2:5">Y. Sot. VI, 21ᵃ</cite> top <he>פ׳ כהנת וכ׳</he> such and such is a priest’s daughter, and she has prostituted herself &c.; a. fr.—Ch. <cite ref="Q01088"><he>פְּלַן</he></cite>.
